glass: stemmed cocktail glass (about 180 ml), chilled, no ice
notes: v1.1 (round 3): a 3:1 Manhattan on rye, stirred, served up, lemon peel. One change, the pineapple: a small square of fresh pineapple (about 15 g; ~7.5 ml juice, my estimate) pressed in the mixing glass with half a teaspoon of rich syrup and strained out, from the cocktail Imbibe! pdf 231 says the Prince of Wales is credited with (its 'powdered sugar to taste' is the syrup). v1 at 2:1 with 10 ml juice went OUT on acid (0.18 vs 0.14): the pineapple's acid is paid for with 10 ml less vermouth, and the syrup puts back the sugar. Maraschino and champagne left out.
